title: LIBS 7102 · Midterm
subtitle: Wednesday Oct 28, in class: four or five two-paragraph answers from about six, closed book, two hours, on paper; lectures 1 to 5
description: The LIBS 7102 midterm in its own format. The rules and how to spend 120 minutes; how to write a two-paragraph answer the marker rewards, with one question answered three ways; a moral-reasoning drill of trick and analysis tasks; all twenty-five listed practice questions answered in writing against a marker's checklist; two mock midterms of six questions with computing cases, answer four; and a one-page answer-skeleton sheet to memorize the night before.
intro:
:::exam Midterm facts
**Midterm: Wednesday Oct 28, in class.** Closed book, two hours, on paper, 20 % of the course. You write four or five two-paragraph answers, choosing from about six (for example, answer 4 of 6). Questions cover lectures 1 to 5 and are taken from the practice list (rare) or very similar to it (typical), often paired with a computing case or asking you to argue a side. It gathers every listed practice question from the five lecture modules.
:::

steps.note: read the rules and the time split (5 min)
do every item: this question scores all or nothing
write each listed answer before revealing; skip the ones you aced in the lecture modules
answer four of six in 100 minutes, on paper if you can
read the skeletons and recite the lists; print the sheet
if time is left, a second timed run
